comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Core business is electric power generation and distribution; telephone service is secondary, unlike ATN's telecom operator model.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Sells billing and network software and outsourced IT services to operators; it does not run connectivity networks.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Cloud phone software and web hosting for small businesses; no owned networks or rural wireless or broadband service.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Integrated Alaska telco selling wireless, broadband, enterprise and government connectivity over its own networks, like ATN.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Cloud communications software sold as subscriptions; it runs no connectivity networks and serves a different customer base.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Rural telecom operator selling broadband, voice and business connectivity over its own fiber and telephone networks.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Rural and midsize wireless and wireline operator with own networks, selling consumer and business connectivity, similar to ATN.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Primarily a REIT leasing fiber and copper capacity to carriers; retail broadband is secondary to wholesale infrastructure leasing.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Satellite broadband plus defense electronics manufacturing; differs in technology, end markets and product mix from ATN.
